Author: fire
Name: FireGaze
Punchline: 提供对第三方插件简介汉化等功能
Description:
第三方插件简介汉化
第三方插件仓库坏链检测
浏览插件仓库阻止列表被自动重载顶回顶部（已知问题：拦截可能不生效，见插件内「插件安装器」页说明）

Localization of third-party plugin descriptions; dead-link detection for third-party plugin repositories; keeping the installer list from being rebuilt out from under you while browsing (known issue: the blocking may not always take effect - see the "Plugin Installer" tab in the plugin).
